notes: Garruk, Unleashed, printed: '[-7]: You get an emblem with "At the beginning of YOUR end step, you may search your library ..."' I make the emblem and decline at my own end step; the turn is then advanced to the opponent's and its end step is reached: the emblem does not trigger there (the step carries no decision words, so a may-offer or a search ask would raise and fail the pack). The Library Beast stays in the library.
